## Outcome

A clean user reaches a ready managed Claude/Codex fleet through one guided `omux setup` flow without insider topology knowledge or hand-edited JSON.

## Flow

1. Preflight platform, harness binaries, keychain/secret-tool, service support, PATH/version truth, and existing config.
2. Collect labeled operator-owned accounts and desired Claude/Codex harnesses.
3. Stage isolated per-account stores and launch provider-owned login, one isolated browser context per identity.
4. Verify redacted identity uniqueness, declared model demand, entitlement/signal provenance, and account health.
5. Ask separately for consent to proactive refresh and managed switching; default deny on ambiguity.
6. Install/enable the user refresh/observation service only after confirmation.
7. Run a bounded readiness proof and print precise `omux repair <label>` actions for failures.

Three steps or fewer from clean install to staged logins/readiness; idempotent rerun; no hand-edited config; macOS live proof and Linux systemd/secret-tool beta proof; redacted clean-user evidence.

Omux owns each adapted application's authentication contract and implementation. Use sufficient native extension mechanisms or an Omux-maintained adapter delivered through plugin/configuration, upstream contribution or explicitly maintained application modification. There is no vendor-provided Omux/Codex hook prerequisite. Experimental candidate proof does not establish unmodified Codex support.

Delivery order: install/activate → Chromium source connection → verified identity and usable authority → renewal → ordinary application integration → same-process handoff. Home Manager owns fleet packages/services/exact-ID host registration; Omux owns custody/enrollment. Development and release identities and namespaces remain isolated.

## This carrier

Shared native UI/CLI setup and repair independently report installation, artifact/channel, resident service, vault, source, verified identity, usable grant and adapter capability. Honor declarative ownership; never overwrite managed files. Explicit receipt selection is required; prefix-only hints infer no ownership.
